name.description: Short stack name, for example python.

description.description: One line describing the projects this stack serves.

detect.description: File names whose presence at the repo root marks a project as this stack.

paths.description: Glob patterns of files that belong to this stack, used to decide which skills and checks apply.

commands.description: Shell commands run from the project root inside the worktree.

setup.description: Shell commands run in order to prepare a fresh worktree.

gc.description: Cleanup settings for caches this stack leaves behind.

apt.description: Ubuntu packages the stack needs on the host.

ci_template.description: Repo-relative path of a CI workflow template for projects without CI.

skills.description: Names of the skill directories in the stack plugin that apply to this stack.
